To address these concerns, we conduct an extensive evaluation comparing harness evolution with simple test-time scaling and discovery baselines under comparable feedback and inference budgets, and also evaluate evolved harnesses on held-out tasks to assess whether the discovered improvements generalize. Experiments on Terminal-Bench 2.1 with GPT-5.4 and Claude Opus 4.6 show that automatic harness evolution does not consistently outperform simple test-time scaling methods and exhibits limited generalization. Our results raise important questions about the effectiveness of automatic harness evolution and highlight the need for fairer evaluation protocols and benchmarks for automatic harness design. Our code is available at https://github.com/rethinking-harness-evolution.

AI.tldr: 本文重新评估了LLM智能体的自动提示框架演化方法，发现在公平对比下，该方法并不优于简单的测试时扩展方法，且泛化能力有限。
AI.motivation: 现有自动提示框架演化方法存在两个问题：1）未与同等推理预算下的测试时搜索基线对比，无法区分性能提升来自框架设计还是额外搜索；2）搜索与评估使用同一基准，存在过拟合风险。
AI.method: 在Terminal-Bench 2.1上用GPT-5.4和Claude Opus 4.6进行大规模实验，将自动提示框架演化与同等反馈/推理预算下的测试时扩展和发现基线进行对比，并在留出任务上评估泛化性。
AI.result: 自动提示框架演化并未持续优于简单的测试时扩展方法，且泛化能力有限。
AI.conclusion: 自动提示框架演化的有效性存疑，需要更公平的评估协议和基准来评估自动提示框架设计方法。

title: RCWT: Measuring Task-Budget Displacement from Coordination Content in LLM Calls
summary: Multi-agent and memory-augmented LLM systems often place coordination content, shared state, prior discussion, tool outputs, summaries, and role instructions, inside the same finite prompt used for the current task. This creates a practical allocation problem: every token spent on coordination is unavailable to task instructions or evidence when a call is assembled under a fixed context budget. We introduce the Roundtable Context Window Test (RCWT), a controlled protocol for measuring this task-budget displacement effect. RCWT varies coordination content while controlling total budget, position order, task family, and scoring. In the main context-dependent recall task at $W=4096$, three commercial models remain near baseline through moderate overhead and then degrade sharply once residual reference evidence falls to a few hundred tokens. Window-scaling summaries are consistent with a task-specific residual-budget interpretation rather than a fixed percentage threshold, but we treat this as descriptive evidence rather than a universal law. To test whether the fixed-budget cliff persists when task evidence remains intact, we add an intact-task ablation: the full task/reference block is kept present while coordination tokens increase by expanding total prompt length. In that setting, all tested calls return every scored field correctly across GPT-4.1-mini, Claude Haiku 4.5, and Gemini 2.5 Flash up to a 95\% coordination ratio. This ablation narrows the claim: the main RCWT cliff is best read as task-budget displacement, not as proof that coordination volume alone causes semantic interference in the original open-ended task. RCWT is therefore a measurement primitive for context-allocation budgeting, not a complete theory of multi-agent benefit or session-level coordination.

AI.tldr: 本文提出RCWT测试协议，用于测量多智能体LLM系统中协调内容占用上下文预算导致的任务性能下降效应。实验发现当协调内容过多挤压任务证据时，模型性能会急剧下降；但如果保持任务证据完整，即使协调比例高达95%，模型仍能正确完成任务。
AI.motivation: 多智能体和记忆增强型LLM系统通常将协调内容、共享状态、历史讨论、工具输出、摘要和角色指令都塞进同一个有限长度的提示中，导致每个分配给协调的token都会挤占任务指令或证据的空间，造成上下文预算分配问题。现有研究缺乏对这种"任务预算位移效应"的系统性测量方法。
AI.method: 提出Roundtable Context Window Test (RCWT)控制实验协议：在固定上下文预算下变化协调内容量，同时控制位置顺序、任务族和评分方式。主要实验在W=4096的上下文相关召回任务上进行，并设计了完整任务消融实验（保持任务/参考块完整，通过扩展总提示长度增加协调token）。
AI.result: 三个商业模型在中等开销下保持基线表现，当剩余参考证据降至几百个token时性能急剧下降。窗口缩放摘要符合任务特定残差预算解释。完整任务消融实验中，GPT-4.1-mini、Claude Haiku 4.5和Gemini 2.5 Flash在协调比例高达95%时仍能正确返回所有评分字段。
AI.conclusion: 主要RCWT性能悬崖应被理解为任务预算位移效应，而非协调量本身导致语义干扰。RCWT是上下文分配预算的测量原语，而非多智能体收益或会话级协调的完整理论。

title: A Calibrated Multimodal Ensemble for Ambivalence/Hesitancy Recognition: System Description and Private-Test Submission Strategy
summary: Ambivalence and hesitancy (A/H) undermine digital behaviour-change interventions, and recognizing them automatically from video is the goal of the ABAW A/H challenge on the BAH dataset. We describe our system for the 11th edition of the challenge: a calibrated, equal-weight ensemble of three fusion models over frozen face, audio, text, and pose embeddings, which reaches 0.7358 macro-F1 on the public test set. This year's private test, released on a disjoint set of 30 new participants, is scored on five allowed submissions; we report the configuration and rationale of each of our five submissions, and, where already available, the private-test score obtained. Our first submission, an exact replica of the calibrated ensemble tuned only on public validation, scored 0.7361 macro-F1 on the private test, matching our public-test estimate almost exactly and confirming the pipeline generalizes to unseen participants without leakage.

AI.tldr: 本文针对ABAW A/H挑战赛，提出了一种基于面部、音频、文本和姿态特征的校准等权集成融合模型，在公开测试集上达到0.7358 macro-F1，并在私有测试集上保持了一致性能（0.7361 macro-F1），证明了该方法的泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 数字行为干预中的矛盾心理和犹豫不决会影响干预效果，而自动从视频中识别这些状态具有重要应用价值，这是ABAW A/H挑战赛的核心目标。
AI.method: 采用校准的等权集成方法，融合三个基于冻结的面部、音频、文本和姿态嵌入的模型。
AI.result: 公开测试集macro-F1为0.7358；首次提交（仅在公开验证上调整的校准集成副本）在私有测试集上得分为0.7361 macro-F1，与公开测试结果几乎一致。
AI.conclusion: 该管道能够泛化到未见参与者，没有数据泄露问题，性能稳定可靠。

title: On-Device Deep Research at 4B: Exposure Bounds Faithfulness, Retrieval Bounds Coverage
summary: On-device research agents search a corpus, read sources, and write a cited brief on a personal laptop. Whether their citations are faithful, and at what cost, is unmeasured for a deployable small model. This study fixes one 4B generator on a 24 GB laptop and asks what makes its citations faithful. It separates two quantities usually reported as one number. Cited claim faithfulness asks whether the cited source supports the claim. Trustworthy coverage asks whether the agent also cites the right sources. The study crosses how much of each source the generator sees, 400 against 1500 characters, with the quality of the sources supplied, gold papers against retrieved papers. Two levers fall out, and they act on different outcomes. Exposure sets faithfulness. More of each source lifts faithfulness from 0.45 to 0.58 on retrieved sources and from 0.37 to 0.58 on gold sources, and the two settings converge, so faithfulness is bound by exposure, not by whether the source is correct. The exposure lift is robust to a second, independent judge; the exact convergence is tight under the primary judge and only approximate under the second. Retrieval sets coverage. Trustworthy coverage stays near 0.22 on retrieved sources at any exposure, because recall is held near 0.40, so exposure cannot fix which sources are cited. The extra exposure costs about 235 output tokens. The practical recipe is to raise per source exposure first, cheaply, and then treat retrieval recall as the only remaining lever.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了一个部署在笔记本电脑上的4B参数量研究助手，发现引文忠实度受限于模型对每个源文本的暴露量（从400字提升到1500字可使忠实度从0.45提升到0.58），而可信覆盖率受限于检索召回率（约0.40），两者独立作用。提升暴露量成本较低（约235个输出token），而提升检索质量是改善覆盖率的唯一杠杆。
AI.motivation: 现有的小型设备端研究代理缺乏对引文忠实性和成本的系统评估，且已有工作通常将两个关键指标混为一谈，无法区分是源文本支持了主张还是代理引用了正确的源。
AI.method: 固定一个4B参数生成器在24GB笔记本电脑上，交叉实验两个因素：(1) 每个源文本的暴露量（400 vs 1500字符）；(2) 源文本质量（黄金论文 vs 检索论文）。分别测量"引文主张忠实度"和"可信覆盖率"两个指标。
AI.result: 提升暴露量使忠实度从0.45提升到0.58（检索源）和从0.37提升到0.58（黄金源），两者收敛；可信覆盖率始终停留在0.22左右（检索源），因为召回率固定为0.40。额外暴露成本约235个输出token。
AI.conclusion: 实用方案是优先低成本提升每个源文本的暴露量，然后专注于提升检索召回率作为改善可信覆盖率的唯一杠杆。

title: Fin-Analyst at FinMMEval 2026 Task 3: A Live Hybrid Trading Agent with LLM Specialists and Rule-Based Signals
comment: 14 pages, 7 tables, 1 figure. CLEF 2026 FinMMEval Task 3 Working Notes
summary: Large language model (LLM) trading agents show promising performance in equity markets, yet remain narrowly focused on US equities with little evidence from live deployment. We present Fin-Analyst, a hybrid agent for FinMMEval 2026 Task 3: an eight-specialist LLM pipeline over news, SEC filings, fundamentals, analyst forecasts, technical indicators, and social sentiment, aggregated by a Meta-Agent for Tesla (TSLA), and a lightweight rule based three-signal vote for Bitcoin (BTC). On the final official leaderboard (accessed 2026-07-05), Fin-Analyst ranks first of all agents on TSLA with a +13.51% return, +28.33 points over Buy-and-Hold (Sharpe 4.10, 88% win rate), while the BTC vote ends flat yet well above a sharply falling baseline. Relative to the interim performance, the asset ranking reversed, indicating that short live windows yield volatility-sensitive rankings. Ablation identifies event-driven 8-K disclosures as the most influential TSLA signal. Error analysis shows that the memoryless agents repeat wrong calls for days at a time, and that the fixed-threshold BTC rules lost money by trading on noise in a sideways market while the LLM pipeline gained under similar conditions, motivating a memory-aware, LLM-based successor for both assets.

AI.tldr: 提出Fin-Analyst混合交易智能体系统，在TSLA上获得第一（+13.51%收益，Sharpe 4.10），而在BTC上通过轻量级规则表现平淡。消融实验发现8-K披露是最重要信号，错误分析揭示无记忆智能体重复错误、固定阈值在震荡市中失效，因此提出基于LLM的记忆感知方案。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM交易智能体主要聚焦美股且缺乏真实部署证据，本文旨在构建一个可在实际环境中运行的混合交易智能体，并覆盖不同资产类别（股票和加密货币）。
AI.method: 针对TSLA采用八专家LLM流水线（覆盖新闻、SEC文件、基本面、分析师预测、技术指标、社会情绪），由元智能体聚合；针对BTC采用轻量级基于规则的三信号投票系统。
AI.result: 在FinMMEval 2026 Task 3官方排行榜上，TSLA智能体以+13.51%收益排名第一，超买入持有28.33个百分点（Sharpe 4.10，胜率88%）；BTC规则系统收益持平但优于大幅下跌的基准。短期窗口内资产排名发生逆转，显示排名对波动敏感。
AI.conclusion: 事件驱动的8-K披露是最重要信号；无记忆智能体会连续多日重复错误判断；固定阈值规则在震荡市中因交易噪声而亏损，而LLM流水线在类似条件下能获利，因此未来需为两种资产开发基于LLM的记忆感知方案。

title: Overview of Cross-Component In-loop Filters in Video Coding Standards
comment: This paper was submitted and accepted by ZTE Communications
summary: In-loop filters have been comprehensively explored during the development of video coding standards due to their remarkable noise-reduction capability. In the early stage of video coding, in-loop filters, such as Deblocking Filter, Sample Adaptive Offset, and Adaptive Loop Filter, were performed separately for each component. Recently, cross-component filters were studied to improve the chroma fidelity by exploiting correlations between the luma and chroma channels. This paper summarizes the cross-component filters used in the state-of-the-art video coding standard. Specifically, it includes the Cross-Component Adaptive Loop Filter and Cross-Component Sample Adaptive Offset. Cross-component filters aim to reduce compression artifacts based on the correlation between different components and provide more accurate pixel reconstruction values. In this paper, we introduce the origin, development, and status of cross-component filters in the current video coding standards. Finally, we had some discussions on the further evolutions of cross-component filters.

AI.tldr: 本文综述了视频编码标准中跨分量滤波器的起源、发展和现状，包括跨分量自适应环路滤波（CC-ALF）和跨分量样本自适应偏移（CC-SAO），并讨论了未来发展方向。
AI.motivation: 传统环路滤波器对各分量单独处理，未能充分利用亮度和色度通道之间的相关性来提升色度保真度，因此需要研究跨分量滤波技术。
AI.method: 本文系统梳理了当前视频编码标准中的跨分量滤波器，重点介绍了CC-ALF和CC-SAO两种方法，它们基于不同分量间的相关性来减少压缩伪影并提供更精确的像素重建值。
AI.result: 跨分量滤波器能够利用亮度和色度通道之间的相关性，有效减少压缩伪影，提升色度重建精度。
AI.conclusion: 跨分量滤波器在当前视频编码标准中发挥了重要作用，未来仍有进一步演进的空间。

title: How Many Tasks Are Enough for Agent Benchmark Decisions? A Replay Analysis of Public LLM Agent Benchmarks
comment: KDD 2026 Workshop Agentic AI Evaluation and Trustworthiness
summary: Agent benchmarks often compare two agents after all tasks have run, but costly evaluations make partial runs tempting. A task fraction alone does not show whether a partial run supports the same pairwise conclusion as the completed benchmark. We study this question by replaying completed public task-level records from SWE-bench, AppWorld, and tau-bench. A partial budget counts as enough only when it supports the completed benchmark's decision, covers required task groups, and leaves no more than a target fraction of comparisons unresolved. The required task fraction varies sharply. At the strict 0 percentage point threshold on a 5 percentage point budget grid, AppWorld first meets all targets at 15 percent, tau-bench at 25 percent, and SWE-bench Verified at 90 percent; SWE-bench Lite does not meet all targets by 95 percent under the primary coverage rule. Partial-evaluation reports should state how much one agent must outperform another, how tasks are selected, what coverage rule is required, what decision rule is used, and how many comparisons may remain unresolved.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了在agent基准测试中，仅使用部分任务（而非完整基准）进行评估时，能否得出与完整基准相同的 pairwise 结论。通过回放SWE-bench、AppWorld和tau-bench的公开任务级记录，发现不同基准所需的任务比例差异巨大（从15%到90%以上），并提出了评估部分运行结果应报告的关键要素。
AI.motivation: Agent基准测试通常需要运行所有任务后才能比较两个agent，但完整评估成本高昂，促使人们考虑仅运行部分任务。然而，仅凭任务完成比例无法判断部分运行是否能支持与完整基准相同的 pairwise 结论。本文旨在量化这一差距，为部分评估的可靠性提供指导。
AI.method: 通过回放SWE-bench、AppWorld和tau-bench的已完成的公开任务级记录，定义"足够"的部分预算需满足三个条件：支持完整基准的决策、覆盖所需任务组、未解决的比较不超过目标比例。在5个百分点预算网格上以严格的0百分点阈值进行测试。
AI.result: 不同基准所需的任务比例差异显著：AppWorld在15%时首次满足所有目标，tau-bench在25%，SWE-bench Verified在90%，而SWE-bench Lite在95%时仍未满足所有目标。
AI.conclusion: 部分评估报告应明确说明：一个agent必须超越另一个agent多少、如何选择任务、所需的覆盖规则、使用的决策规则，以及可能有多少比较仍未解决。

title: FinResearchBench II: A Deep Research Benchmark with Consensus-Derived Gold Rubrics for Distinguishing Financial Report Quality
summary: Deep research agents are increasingly used to produce long-form financial reports, yet large-scale evaluation remains bottlenecked by the need for human experts to define and execute high-quality rubrics. We address this problem by proposing a scalable pipeline for generating high-quality rubrics without human experts in the final loop. We build a financial deep research benchmark from 104 real-world user queries and automatically synthesize 14,450 query-specific candidate rubrics from model-generated reports. To justify removing human experts from rubric execution, we compare rubric judgments from three human experts with those from a three-LLM judge panel on a sampled subset, and show that LLM-based evaluation is sufficiently consistent with human evaluation to replace it for large-scale rubric screening, including 98.67\% label-level agreement on jointly unanimous items. We then derive consensus-derived gold rubrics through two filters: a strict consistency filter, which keeps a rubric only if the three LLM judges unanimously agree on every report under the same query, and a distinguishability filter, which keeps a rubric only if it assigns at least one majority-yes and at least one majority-no label across the evaluated systems. This process retains 3,687 consistency-passed rubrics, of which 2,600 remain distinguishable and form the final set of consensus-derived gold rubrics. Using this final rubric set, we obtain clearly differentiated rankings across 10 deep research systems, with item-level pass rates ranging from 58.58\% to 22.23\%. More broadly, because the pipeline removes human-expert execution from rubric generation and evaluation, it is naturally scalable for benchmark evaluation, automatic system comparison, and future studies of evaluation-driven system improvement.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种无需人类专家参与的可扩展流水线，用于自动生成高质量评分标准并评估金融深度研究报告。通过104个真实用户查询，自动合成了14,450个候选评分标准，最终筛选出2,600个共识衍生黄金标准，并在10个深度研究系统上实现了清晰的性能排名。
AI.motivation: 大规模金融深度研究报告的评估严重依赖人类专家定义和执行评分标准，这成为评估流程的瓶颈。需要一种可扩展、无需人类专家参与的方法来生成高质量的评估标准。
AI.method: 1) 从104个真实用户查询构建金融深度研究基准；2) 自动合成14,450个查询特定候选评分标准；3) 比较三位人类专家与三个LLM评委的评分一致性，验证LLM可替代人类进行大规模评分标准筛选；4) 通过一致性过滤器（三个LLM评委对同一查询下所有报告一致同意）和区分度过滤器（评分标准至少分配一个多数"是"和一个多数"否"标签）筛选出2,600个共识衍生黄金标准。
AI.result: LLM评估与人类评估在共同一致的项上达到98.67%的标签级一致性；最终获得2,600个可区分的黄金标准；10个深度研究系统的项级通过率从58.58%到22.23%，实现清晰的排名区分。
AI.conclusion: 该流水线成功去除了人类专家在评分标准生成和执行中的参与，具有天然的可扩展性，适用于基准评估、自动系统比较以及未来评估驱动的系统改进研究。

title: RegHead: Non-Humanoid Head Blendshapes via Feed-Forward Registration
summary: We present RegHead, a framework for constructing semantic blendshape sets for animatable non-humanoid head avatars. With a fixed expression vocabulary, semantic blendshapes provide a low-dimensional and interpretable animation interface and support cross-identity retargeting. Building such blendshape sets remains expensive because (i) expression-consistent supervision is scarce, (ii) generated 4D assets typically lack correspondence, and (iii) facial motion is highly localized. We propose (1) a large-scale dataset of non-humanoid identities paired with a shared expression vocabulary, obtained by expanding a small artist-rigged library via fine-tuned image editing; (2) a dense stochastic anchor motion representation tailored to localized facial deformations; and (3) a fast feed-forward registration model that converts unregistered expression meshes into a corresponded blendshape basis by predicting anchor-based deformations from the neutral shape. Experiments show that our approach produces higher-fidelity expression meshes than baselines, while running orders of magnitude faster than optimization. We further demonstrate real-time retargeting from human face tracking signals to non-humanoid characters, capturing both head pose and localized facial motions. Our project page is available at https://snap-research.github.io/RegHead/.

AI.tldr: RegHead框架通过有限的表情数据，构建非人形头部角色的语义Blendshape集合，实现高质量、可解释、可重定向的动画控制。
AI.motivation: 构建非人形头部角色的语义Blendshape集成本高昂，原因在于表情一致的监督数据稀缺、生成的4D资产缺乏对应关系、面部运动高度局部化。现有方法难以高效、高保真地解决这些问题。
AI.method: (1) 通过微调图像编辑扩展现有小规模艺术家绑定库，构建大规模非人形角色与共享表情词汇配对的数据集；(2) 提出密集随机锚点运动表示，专门处理局部面部变形；(3) 设计快速前馈配准模型，从未注册的表情网格中预测基于锚点的变形，转化为对应的Blendshape基。
AI.result: 该方法生成的表情网格保真度优于基线方法，运行速度比优化方法快多个数量级，并实现了从人脸追踪信号到非人形角色的实时重定向。
AI.conclusion: RegHead有效降低了非人形头部角色语义Blendshape集的构建成本，在保真度和效率上均取得显著优势，支持实时人脸重定向应用。

title: PM-Bench: Evaluating Prospective Memory in LLM Agents
comment: Published as a conference paper at COLM 2026
summary: A significant challenge in agentic AI is prospective memory: the ability to execute an intention at a specific future cue or state while other activities are ongoing. We introduce PM-Bench, a text-based benchmark for measuring prospective memory capabilities in modern LLM agents. Inspired by the Virtual Week paradigm from cognitive science, PM-Bench evaluates how well LLM agents maintain user intentions, execute delayed intentions, and monitor latent environment changes. Over the course of a simulated seven-day week, agents must continue an ongoing activity while deciding whether any deferred task is due. We compare eight state-of-the-art LLMs on PM-Bench under eight different agent configurations. PM-Bench proves challenging across all settings: the best method, a GPT-5.4 agent, reaches only 65.1\% F1 score under our evaluation. Furthermore, no single strategy for improving prospective memory dominates across models. We release PM-Bench as a controlled testbed for diagnosing these failures and developing training or inference-time interventions that support reliable prospective behavior.

AI.tldr: 本文提出PM-Bench基准，用于评估LLM智能体的前瞻记忆能力。在模拟七天的虚拟环境中，最佳GPT-5.4智能体仅达到65.1% F1分数，表明前瞻记忆对当前大模型仍是重大挑战。
AI.motivation: 智能体AI面临前瞻记忆（在中断其他活动时，于特定未来线索或状态下执行意图）的显著挑战，但目前缺乏系统评估这一能力的基准。
AI.method: 受认知科学Virtual Week范式启发，设计文本基准PM-Bench，在模拟七天虚拟周中，智能体需持续进行活动的同时判断是否需执行延迟任务。评估8个SOTA LLM在8种配置下的表现。
AI.result: 最佳方法GPT-5.4智能体仅达65.1% F1分数；没有单一策略能跨模型主导提升前瞻记忆。
AI.conclusion: PM-Bench作为受控测试平台，可用于诊断前瞻记忆失败，并开发支持可靠前瞻行为的训练或推理时干预方法。

title: A Shared Subcircuit Lets LLMs Count Down Across Tasks
summary: Writing a sentence of exactly twelve words; ending a DNA sequence at the right codon; formatting an ASCII table. These are all tasks that language models can do that requires tracking how many tokens remain before a target. In this work, we identify in Llama-3.1-70B-Instruct a general mechanism for performing these tasks: a "countdown subcircuit" that compares the current position to a goal length and estimates the time remaining until then. We first isolate a countdown subcircuit in a controlled setting, in which the model is tasked with writing a fixed-length sentence ending in a specified word. We then investigate the geometry of the representations used by the subcircuit, and find that the subcircuit uses an identical motif previously identified in a frontier LLM on a separate task, thus suggesting that this motif is shared across models. Finally, we use unsupervised probing on a natural language dataset to find a variety of other tasks where this subcircuit is used, including tasks where the goal length is inferred from context rather than explicitly stated. Our work suggests that reverse-engineering subcircuits allows us to understand how behaviors generalize from a single example to many different tasks and even models.

AI.tldr: 本文在Llama-3.1-70B-Instruct模型中识别出一种通用的"倒计时子电路"机制，用于追踪剩余token数量以完成长度控制任务，并发现该机制在多个任务和模型中共享。
AI.motivation: 理解语言模型如何执行需要追踪剩余token数量的任务（如写固定长度句子、DNA序列对齐、ASCII表格格式化等），揭示模型内部通用的计数机制。
AI.method: 首先在可控环境（固定长度句子生成）中隔离倒计时子电路，然后研究其表征几何结构，发现与先前在前沿LLM中发现的相同主题；最后通过无监督探针在自然语言数据集中寻找该子电路的其他应用场景。
AI.result: 成功识别出倒计时子电路；发现该子电路使用的表征主题与先前在另一任务中发现的主题相同，说明该主题跨模型共享；在自然语言数据中发现多种其他任务也使用了该子电路，包括目标长度从上下文推断而非明确给定的情况。
AI.conclusion: 逆向工程子电路有助于理解行为如何从单个示例泛化到多种不同任务甚至不同模型，为理解LLM的通用机制提供了新视角。

title: Critic Experience Bank: Self-Evolving Step-Level Confidence Estimation for LLM Agents
summary: LLM agents act in external environments where each action changes the state that later decisions condition on, and where a single wrong step can waste interaction budget or trigger irreversible side effects long before the final failure is observed. Reliable deployment therefore requires \emph{step-level confidence estimation}: a calibrated probability that each proposed action is productive, available \emph{before} the action is executed. Existing LLM confidence estimators are designed to score a response from the given prompt, but agent confidence also depends on execution consequences: whether similar actions in similar situations actually advanced the task after the environment responded. We introduce the \method (\methodshort), a self-evolving critic framework in which an LLM critic accumulates evidence from its own past judgments and their observed consequences. After each trajectory, a hindsight LLM that sees the full execution feedback votes on whether each step was productive. The resulting pseudo-labels populate a memory bank from which related productive and unproductive experiences are retrieved into the critic's prompt whenever a similar step recurs. \methodshort requires no training and uses no ground truth step labels. Across three agent benchmarks and three critic backbones, \methodshort attains the best calibration (ECE and Brier) and ranking (AUC) in every dataset--critic combination, reducing ECE by up to $54\%$ relative to the strongest training-free baseline.

AI.tldr: 提出SELF-STEP方法，利用自演进批评框架为LLM智能体提供行动前的步骤级置信度估计，无需训练即可显著提升校准性能。
AI.motivation: LLM智能体在外部环境中执行动作时，一步错误可能浪费交互预算或引发不可逆后果，现有置信度估计方法无法捕捉动作执行后的环境反馈，缺乏步骤级的校准概率。
AI.method: 构建自演进批评框架：后见LLM基于完整轨迹投票生成伪标签，存入记忆库；当类似步骤再次出现时，检索相关成功/失败经验注入批评者提示中，无需训练或真实标签。
AI.result: 在三个智能体基准和三个批评骨干上，SELF-STEP在所有数据集-批评组合中取得最佳校准（ECE和Brier）和排序（AUC）性能，ECE相比最强无训练基线降低高达54%。
AI.conclusion: SELF-STEP通过记忆历史判断及其后果，实现了无需训练的步骤级置信度估计，显著提升LLM智能体的可靠部署能力。

title: The GEST-Engine: From Event Graphs to Synthetic Video. A Full Technical Report
summary: We present the GEST-Engine, a complete system that goes from natural-language text to fully-annotated multi-actor video. At its core is an explicit world model: rather than encoding state as a learned latent, the engine maintains a complete, inspectable representation of the world (which actors exist, where they are, what they are doing, which objects they hold, and how events relate in time and space), expressed as a formal Graph of Events in Space and Time (GEST) and realized deterministically inside the open world of a commercial game engine driven through an open-source multiplayer scripting framework. GESTs are produced either procedurally or by an agentic text-to-GEST system in which an LLM Director plans a story through tool calls validated by a programmatic state backend, so every generated specification is executable by construction. A GEST then enters a four-stage execution pipeline: graph parsing and validation, entity and action grounding, temporal orchestration (Allen-style constraints resolved by Floyd-Warshall transitive closure), and execution and capture. In a single simulation pass the engine emits frame-aligned RGB video, dense per-pixel depth, instance segmentation, per-actor skeletal pose, per-frame pairwise spatial-relation graphs, 2D bounding boxes, event-to-frame temporal mappings, and natural-language descriptions, all at zero marginal annotation cost. We further describe an in-game world editor, runtime capability extraction, a text-generation pipeline, and a production system that renders corpora at scale across parallel virtual machines. Because every frame traces back to a semantic specification, the engine guarantees object permanence, multi-actor coordination, and temporal consistency by construction, making its output valuable as training data, evaluation benchmarks, and diagnostic tools for video understanding.

AI.tldr: 提出GEST-Engine系统，能从自然语言文本生成完全标注的多演员视频，核心是显式世界模型（GEST图），通过确定性执行保证标注一致性和零边际标注成本。
AI.motivation: 现有视频数据生成方法缺乏显式世界模型，导致标注不一致、物体恒存性差、多演员协调困难，且人工标注成本高昂。
AI.method: 以GEST（时空事件图）为核心，包含文本到GEST的智能体系统（LLM导演+程序化验证）和四阶段执行流水线（图解析验证、实体动作接地、时序编排、执行捕获），在商业游戏引擎中确定性实现。
AI.result: 单次模拟输出RGB视频、深度图、实例分割、骨骼姿态、空间关系图、2D边界框、事件-帧映射及文本描述，零额外标注成本。
AI.conclusion: 该系统保证物体恒存性、多演员协调和时序一致性，适用于训练数据、评估基准和视频理解诊断工具。

title: Isolation as a First-Class Principle for LLM-Agent System Safety: Concepts, Taxonomy, Challenges and Future Directions
summary: The capability of LLM agents to function as the ``brain'' of a system fundamentally expands the scope of analysis beyond a standalone model. Consequently, safety is no longer only about input--output content alignment. It also concerns system behavior and real-world execution outcomes. However, the current literature is fragmented across attack types, applications, and benchmarks. This makes it hard to explain why failures such as prompt injection, tool misuse, and memory poisoning often share the same structural cause, and how they spread through an agent workflow. In this survey, we treat isolation as a first-class principle for LLM-agent system safety. By isolation, we refer to the separation of user inputs, tool access, execution channels, inter-agent communication, and environment-originated context. We organize the literature with a boundary-centric taxonomy of five boundaries: user-agent, agent-tool, agent-execution, agent-agent, and system-environment. This view helps identify where the loss of isolation first occurs, how compromise propagates across boundaries, and which defenses are most relevant at each interface. We also summarize cross-boundary failure paths, discuss open challenges, and outline a research agenda for isolation-by-construction in future agent systems.

AI.tldr: 本文系统综述了LLM智能体系统的安全问题，提出将"隔离"作为第一性原则，并通过五类边界（用户-智能体、智能体-工具、智能体-执行、智能体-智能体、系统-环境）的边界中心分类法来组织文献，分析了隔离失效如何导致提示注入、工具滥用、记忆投毒等安全故障及其跨边界传播路径。
AI.motivation: 当前关于LLM智能体安全的研究分散在不同攻击类型、应用场景和基准测试中，缺乏统一框架来解释为何提示注入、工具滥用、记忆投毒等不同故障往往共享相同的结构成因，以及它们如何在智能体工作流中传播扩散。
AI.method: 提出以"隔离"为核心原则，构建边界中心分类法，识别五类边界（用户-智能体、智能体-工具、智能体-执行、智能体-智能体、系统-环境），并据此系统梳理文献，分析隔离失效的首次发生点、危害跨边界传播路径及各接口的最相关防御措施。
AI.result: 建立了统一的边界分类框架，可定位安全故障的初始隔离失效点，追踪危害如何跨边界传播，并为每个边界接口匹配最相关的防御策略。
AI.conclusion: 强调了"隔离"作为LLM智能体系统安全的第一性原则的重要性，总结了跨边界故障路径，指出了当前开放挑战，并勾勒了未来智能体系统"通过构建实现隔离"的研究议程。

title: QUBO-Optimized Evidence Selection for Retrieval-Augmented Question Answering with Unconventional Solvers
summary: Retrieval-augmented question answering depends on selecting evidence passages that jointly support answer generation. However, many RAG pipelines rely on top-\(k\) ranking, where passages are selected mainly by individual relevance scores, even though multi-hop questions often require complementary evidence satisfying multiple information requirements. Recent LLM-based selectors address this by treating retrieval as set selection, but using an LLM for this intermediate stage can be costly and difficult to scale. In this work, we formulate evidence selection as a Quadratic Unconstrained Binary Optimization (QUBO) problem. Given a question, candidate passages, and decomposed information requirements, our method constructs an energy function that balances relevance, requirement coverage, support strength, redundancy, complementarity, and compactness. Low-energy solutions correspond to compact evidence subsets that cover the needed requirements while avoiding unnecessary or repetitive context. The selected passages are then passed to a downstream language model for answer generation, separating combinatorial evidence selection from semantic answer generation. We evaluate the proposed QUBO selector on HotpotQA and compare it with LLM-based set selectors and non-LLM baselines including BM25, relevance top-\(k\), maximal marginal relevance, hybrid lexical--semantic ranking, greedy coverage, and random selection. The QUBO selector achieves competitive exact-match and token-F1 performance relative to LLM-based selectors while providing a solver-compatible formulation for structured evidence selection. These results suggest that multi-hop evidence selection can be cast as discrete optimization, opening a path toward RAG pipelines where LLMs are reserved for semantic processing and answer generation, while context selection is handled by Ising/QUBO-compatible solvers.

AI.tldr: 本文将证据选择形式化为二次无约束二元优化（QUBO）问题，通过构建能量函数平衡相关性、需求覆盖、支持强度、冗余、互补性和紧凑性，选择最优证据子集用于多跳检索增强问答，在HotpotQA上取得了与基于LLM的选择器竞争的性能，同时将LLM保留用于语义处理和答案生成。
AI.motivation: 现有RAG管道依赖top-k排序，仅通过单个相关性分数选择段落，难以满足多跳问题中需要互补证据的要求；基于LLM的选择器虽然将检索视为集合选择，但成本高昂且难以扩展。
AI.method: 将证据选择建模为QUBO问题，构建能量函数平衡多方面目标（相关性、需求覆盖、支持强度、冗余、互补性、紧凑性），低能量解对应最优证据子集，随后传递给下游语言模型生成答案。
AI.result: 在HotpotQA上，QUBO选择器在精确匹配和token-F1指标上达到了与基于LLM的选择器竞争的性能，并优于BM25、top-k、最大边际相关性等非LLM基线。
AI.conclusion: 多跳证据选择可以转化为离散优化问题，为RAG管道提供了一种新路径：LLM专注于语义处理和答案生成，而上下文选择由Ising/QUBO兼容求解器处理。

title: Rough Path Signature-Guided Geometry Augmentation for Few-Shot Industrial Surface Defect Detection
summary: Few-shot industrial defect detection remains difficult for standard supervised detectors, which achieve poor performance on boundary-dominated industrial defects. This paper proposes rough path signature-guided geometry augmentation (RPS-GA), a geometry-aware approach in which Canny edge contours are treated as ordered planar paths whose truncated second-order signature responses, especially the antisymmetric Lévy-area term, are aggregated into a spatial map that highlights boundary-related structure through two fusion operators, SIG-AUG and SGAA. The approach is evaluated on NEU-DET and PCB-Defect under a few-shot protocol with 5, 10, 20, or 50 labeled images per class, using an unmodified YOLOv8n detector throughout. Compared with the baseline, RPS-GA delivers large gains when supervision is limited, although the margin shrinks as more labels become available. On NEU-DET, SIG-AUG raises 10-shot mAP@0.5 from 0.341 to 0.583, whereas on PCB-Defect, SGAA improves 10-shot mAP@0.5 from 0.086 to 0.299 and yields usable detection at 5-shot where the baseline fails entirely. These trends are confirmed by multi-seed evaluation across independent random partitions. Overall, the results indicate that second-order path-signature geometry offers a practical way to strengthen few-shot industrial defect detection without meta-learning or detector redesign.

AI.tldr: 本文提出RPS-GA方法，将Canny边缘轮廓视为有序路径，利用截断二阶路径签名（尤其是反对称Lévy面积项）生成空间图，通过SIG-AUG和SGAA两种融合算子增强边界结构，在不修改YOLOv8n检测器的情况下，显著提升少样本工业缺陷检测性能（如NEU-DET上10-shot mAP@0.5从0.341提升至0.583）。
AI.motivation: 标准监督检测器在少样本场景下对边界主导的工业缺陷检测性能不佳，需要一种不依赖元学习或检测器重构的几何感知增强方法。
AI.method: 将Canny边缘轮廓视为有序平面路径，计算其截断二阶签名响应（特别是反对称Lévy面积项），聚合为空间图突出边界结构，通过SIG-AUG和SGAA两种融合算子进行几何增强。
AI.result: 在NEU-DET和PCB-Defect数据集上，基于未修改的YOLOv8n检测器，在5/10/20/50样本少样本协议下评估。NEU-DET上10-shot mAP@0.5从0.341提升至0.583；PCB-Defect上10-shot mAP@0.5从0.086提升至0.299，5-shot下基线完全失效而该方法有效。
AI.conclusion: 二阶路径签名几何为少样本工业缺陷检测提供了一种实用的增强途径，无需元学习或检测器重新设计，在标签有限时增益显著，随标签增多增益缩小。

title: Accepted Prefixes Are Not All You Need: A Negative Result on PEFT-Based Block-Diffusion Drafting
summary: Speculative decoding accelerates autoregressive language model inference by using a cheap drafter to propose multiple future tokens and a target model to verify them. A common design goal is therefore to improve draft quality while reducing auxiliary parameters and systems overhead. We study a negative result for this direction through PEFT-BD, a same-backbone speculative decoding method in which a LoRA-like adapter acts as a block-diffusion drafter for an autoregressive verifier. PEFT-BD is motivated by several attractive properties: it avoids tokenizer mismatch, avoids loading a separate draft model, adds only a small number of trainable parameters, and uses a BD3LM-style denoising objective to propose a block of tokens in parallel. Despite these advantages, PEFT-BD does not yield a practical speedup in our Qwen3-0.6B experiments. Although the method obtains nontrivial accepted prefixes, profiling shows that each speculative step requires an adapter-enabled full-backbone draft pass followed by an adapter-disabled full-backbone verification pass. Thus, the drafter is parameter-efficient but not compute-efficient. Our results isolate a simple but important condition for successful speculative decoding: the drafter must be substantially cheaper to execute than the verifier. Longer accepted prefixes alone cannot compensate when draft computation remains verifier-scale.

AI.tldr: PEFT-BD是一种使用LoRA适配器作为块扩散起草器的同骨干投机解码方法，虽然参数高效且无需额外模型加载，但由于起草器和验证器都需要完整骨干计算，导致没有实际加速效果，揭示了投机解码中起草器必须比验证器计算成本更低的关键条件。
AI.motivation: 探索一种参数高效的投机解码方法，通过LoRA适配器在同骨干架构下实现块级扩散起草，避免分词器不匹配、额外模型加载等问题。
AI.method: 使用LoRA适配器作为块扩散起草器（同骨干架构），采用BD3LM-style去噪目标并行生成多个令牌，再由原始模型验证。
AI.result: 在Qwen3-0.6B实验中未获得实际加速，虽然前缀接受率非平凡，但每个投机步骤包含一次适配器启用和一次适配器禁用的完整骨干计算。
AI.conclusion: 投机解码成功的关键条件是起草器必须比验证器计算成本低得多，仅靠更长的接受前缀无法补偿起草器与验证器同规模的计算开销。

title: How to Realize Recursively Self-Improving Agents and Personal Singularity: A Goal-, Scope-, Tool-, and Benchmark-Driven Multi-Agent Architecture
comment: 22 pages, 4 figures, 5 tables, and 4 algorithms. Position and systems-design paper presenting a research architecture and evaluation roadmap
summary: Large language model (LLM) agents can increasingly plan, use tools, maintain memory, and execute long-horizon tasks. These advances motivate two linked questions: how can an agent improve the mechanisms by which it learns and acts, and how can that improvement increase the durable capabilities of its user rather than only the software itself? This paper proposes a governed multi-agent architecture for recursively self-improving agents and introduces personal singularity as a bounded human-AI co-development objective: helping a user approach an expanding, user-defined capability frontier across selected domains. Each agent is defined by a goal contract, bounded scope, validated tool registry, tool-level tests, end-to-end benchmarks, an owner-controlled autonomy policy, a routing policy, memory, and an improvement policy. Out-of-scope tasks are transferred to another accountable agent or to a newly created niche agent. A user-facing Auto-Index selects interactive, hybrid, autonomous, or scheduled operation without overriding external permissions. The architecture combines a fast planner-executor-verifier loop, a slower evidence-gated improvement loop, an external governance plane, decentralized agent lineages, an owner-directed agent foundry, and a Personal Singularity OS coordinating working, computational-imaging, process-learning, and personal-learning agents. We formalize scope, routing, improvement acceptance, bounded goal evolution, tool-first execution, and human capability transfer, and provide safety invariants, benchmark design, and an implementation roadmap. This is a position and systems-design paper, not evidence that unrestricted recursive self-improvement or personal singularity has already been achieved.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种受控多智能体架构，用于递归自改进AI智能体，并以"个人奇点"作为人机协同发展的有界目标，帮助用户在选定领域不断扩展能力边界。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM智能体在规划、工具使用、记忆和长周期任务执行方面不断进步，但如何让智能体改进自身学习与行动机制，以及如何将这些改进转化为用户的持久能力而非仅提升软件本身，这两个问题尚未得到有效解决。
AI.method: 提出受控多智能体架构，每个智能体由目标合约、有界范围、验证过的工具注册表、工具级测试、端到端基准、自主策略、路由策略、记忆和改进策略定义。结合快速规划-执行-验证循环、慢速证据驱动的改进循环、外部治理平面、去中心化智能体谱系、所有者导向的智能体工厂，以及个人奇点操作系统。
AI.result: 形式化了范围、路由、改进接受、有界目标演化、工具优先执行和人类能力转移等机制，并提供了安全不变量、基准设计和实施路线图。属于立场与系统设计论文，尚未实现无限制递归自改进或个人奇点。
AI.conclusion: 该架构为构建安全可控的递归自改进智能体系统提供了理论基础和设计蓝图，有潜力在保持人类控制的前提下实现人机能力协同增长。

title: EVOQUANT: Self-Evolving Verifier-Guided Strategy Optimization for Robust Quantitative Trading
summary: Quantitative strategy optimization remains largely manual, requiring domain experts to identify weak signals, tune risk-control rules, and repeatedly validate iterative revisions. Large language models can accelerate this process, but directly relying on them to rewrite trading strategies often introduces hallucinated edits, strategy drift, and backtest overfitting. We propose EVOQUANT, a self-Evolving Verifier-guided framework for strategy Optimization in Quantitative trading. Our method utilizes LLMs to deeply diagnose performance bottlenecks, generates semantically controlled candidate edits, selects the best strategy through a multi-stage verification pipeline, and distills optimization experience into reusable knowledge for continual self-improvement. We evaluate our method using seven representative strategies: four from the A-share market and three from the Crypto market. Experimental results show that our method significantly improves the Sharpe ratio across all tested strategies: the average test Sharpe increases from -0.298 to 0.538, and the best-performing strategy achieves a 199% relative improvement. Ablation studies and stress tests under stricter conditions further validate the effectiveness and robustness of the framework. Overall, this work transforms quantitative strategy optimization from costly manual trial and error into an automated and verifiable iterative paradigm, offering a new path for applying large language models to financial strategy research.

AI.tldr: 本文提出EVOQUANT框架，利用大语言模型实现量化交易策略的自动化优化，通过多阶段验证和自进化机制，将策略平均夏普比率从-0.298提升至0.538，最佳策略实现199%的相对改进。
AI.motivation: 传统量化策略优化依赖领域专家手动完成，效率低下且成本高昂。虽然大语言模型可用于策略重写，但直接使用会导致幻觉编辑、策略漂移和过拟合等问题，亟需一种自动化且可验证的优化方法。
AI.method: EVOQUANT框架包含四个核心步骤：1）利用LLM深度诊断策略性能瓶颈；2）生成语义受控的候选编辑；3）通过多阶段验证流水线筛选最佳策略；4）将优化经验蒸馏为可复用的知识，实现持续自我改进。
AI.result: 在7个代表性策略（4个A股+3个加密货币）上测试，平均测试夏普比率从-0.298提升至0.538，最佳策略实现199%的相对改进。消融实验和压力测试进一步验证了框架的有效性和鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: EVOQUANT将量化策略优化从昂贵的手工试错转变为自动化、可验证的迭代范式，为大语言模型在金融策略研究中的应用提供了新路径。

title: Policy-Conditioned Constrained Decoding for Column-Level Access Control in Text-to-SQL
summary: Text-to-SQL is increasingly deployed across trust boundaries between data providers and users. Such deployment must balance three competing requirements: policy compliance, answer coverage, and bounded cost. Existing approaches typically decide refusal based on which columns a query mentions and enforce it stochastically. Whether a query is compliant, however, depends not only on which columns appear but on how they are used, and stochastic enforcement cannot deterministically rule out violations. We formalize this requirement as a column-use policy over semantic use: output, filter condition, and aggregation argument. We integrate the policy by aligning each role with grammar productions tracked by the decoder. The resulting system, PCC-SQL, applies a per-token logits mask that deterministically eliminates single-query column-use violations on the supported SQL fragment in a single decoding pass. Across three benchmarks and three open-source models, PCC-SQL achieves 0% Leakage Rate and Coverage up to 88.7% on Spider-CU, while staying within +10% tokens of direct prompting. We additionally assess semantic alignment with execution accuracy.

AI.tldr: PCC-SQL通过在解码过程中对每个token的logits施加掩码，在单次解码中确定性消除列使用违规，实现了政策合规、答案覆盖和成本约束三者平衡，在三个基准测试中达到0%泄露率和最高88.7%覆盖率。
AI.motivation: 现有Text-to-SQL系统在跨信任边界部署时，通常仅基于查询提及的列来决定拒绝，且采用随机执行方式，无法确定性消除违规。然而，查询是否合规不仅取决于列的出现，还取决于列的使用方式（输出、过滤条件、聚合参数），需要更精确的语义级策略控制。
AI.method: 提出列使用策略（column-use policy），将每个列角色（输出、过滤条件、聚合参数）与解码器跟踪的语法产生式对齐。通过PCC-SQL系统，在单次解码中对每个token的logits施加掩码，确定性消除支持的SQL片段上的列使用违规。
AI.result: 在三个基准测试和三个开源模型上，PCC-SQL实现了0%的泄露率，在Spider-CU上覆盖率最高达88.7%，同时token开销控制在直接提示法的+10%以内。
AI.conclusion: PCC-SQL通过确定性策略执行有效平衡了合规性、覆盖率和成本，未来可扩展至更复杂的SQL片段和策略语言。

title: Auditing Data Leakage in Whole-Slide Image Multimodal Benchmarks
summary: Recent vision-language models (VLMs) for computational pathology report striking zero-shot performance on whole-slide image (WSI) visual question answering (VQA) benchmarks. We audit these claims and find them fundamentally compromised by data leakage at two hierarchical levels: patient-level leakage, where slides from the same case appear in both training and test folds, and institutional-level leakage, where different cases nonetheless share staining-batch and scanner signatures through a common Tissue Source Site (TSS). By tracing canonical slide, case, and TSS identifiers across major public resources, we document case level train test overlaps of 92.3~100% on TCGA-derived benchmarks, together with near-complete TSS overlap. We further demonstrate that both leakage levels are linearly decodable from foundation-model feature space, that they induce a measurable accuracy gap between leaked and audit-clean cases on a published checkpoint, and that across multiple published WSI VLMs, peak reported accuracies concentrate on the most heavily contaminated benchmarks. Therefore, the current WSI VQA evaluation cannot distinguish genuine multimodal reasoning from nearest-neighbor retrieval over memorized institutional and patient-specific artifacts. Finally, we outline concrete recommendations for contamination-free evaluation. By addressing benchmark construction, provenance disclosure, and automated overlap auditing, we aim to guide future research toward verifiable claims of progress.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示现有病理学视觉-语言模型在WSI VQA基准上的零样本性能存在严重的数据泄露问题，包括患者级别和机构级别的泄露，导致评估结果无法反映真实的跨模态推理能力。
AI.motivation: 现有病理学VLM声称在WSI VQA任务上具有出色的零样本性能，但这些声称可能因数据泄露而被严重高估，需要进行审计和验证。
AI.method: 通过追踪TCGA衍生基准中患者案例和TSS标识符，量化训练集与测试集的重叠程度；在基础模型特征空间中验证泄露信息的线性可解码性；测量泄露样本与干净样本间的准确率差距。
AI.result: TCGA衍生基准中案例级训练-测试重叠率达92.3%-100%，TSS重叠几乎完全；两种泄露均可从基础模型特征空间中线性解码；泄露样本与干净样本之间存在可测量的准确率差距；高报告准确率集中在污染最严重的基准上。
AI.conclusion: 当前WSI VQA评估无法区分真实的多模态推理与对记忆化的机构及患者特定伪影的最近邻检索，需通过改进基准构建、来源披露和自动化重叠审计来建立无污染的评估体系。

title: Do We Really Need Transformers for Global Spatial Information Extraction in Traffic Forecasting?
comment: 15 pages, 6 figures. Source code available at https://github.com/uuesti/U-Trans
summary: Existing traffic forecasting models commonly focus on extracting spatial dependencies, particularly global spatial information, which characterizes the representations obtained through interactions between each individual node and all nodes across the traffic network. However, the underlying mechanism by which such global information is modeled and extracted remains insufficiently investigated. Whether global information must be extracted by high-degree-of-freedom adaptive attention or can be captured by a simple global aggregation operator remains unclear. For this purpose, we design a controlled ablation framework that replaces only the spatial mixing module to test attention-based global interaction. Across six traffic benchmarks, uniform full-range mixing and standard spatial attention each achieve lower MAE on three datasets, with only a 0.14% difference in mean MAE, while the former reduces node-scale spatial mixing complexity from O(N2) to O(N). Mechanism analysis further decomposes spatial attention into a row-uniform global background and a non-uniform residual. The residual shows dataset-dependent marginal value, suggesting that spatial attention should be justified by stable gains beyond a row-uniform global background. The corresponding source code is publicly available at: https://github.com/uuesti/U-Trans

AI.tldr: 本文通过控制消融实验发现，简单的全局聚合算子（均匀全范围混合）与高自由度的自适应注意力机制在交通预测任务中表现几乎相当（平均MAE仅差0.14%），且前者将复杂度从O(N²)降至O(N)。进一步机制分析将空间注意力分解为行均匀全局背景和非均匀残差，后者边际价值有限，表明空间注意力的使用需要谨慎验证其稳定增益。
AI.motivation: 现有交通预测模型普遍关注全局空间依赖建模，但全局信息的提取机制尚未被充分研究——是否必须依赖高自由度的自适应注意力机制，还是简单的全局聚合算子即可实现，这一问题尚不明确。
AI.method: 设计控制消融框架，仅替换空间混合模块以对比基于注意力的全局交互与均匀全范围混合的效果。在六个交通基准数据集上进行实验，并从机制上将空间注意力分解为行均匀全局背景与非均匀残差进行分析。
AI.result: 均匀全范围混合与标准空间注意力各在三个数据集上取得更优MAE，平均MAE差距仅0.14%；前者将节点级空间混合复杂度从O(N²)降低到O(N)；非均匀残差对性能的贡献具有数据集依赖性，边际价值有限。
AI.conclusion: 空间注意力机制的使用需要以超越行均匀全局背景的稳定增益为前提，否则简单的全局聚合算子可能是更优选择。这为交通预测模型的空间模块设计提供了重要指导。

title: Beyond Binary Detection: A Multi-Dimensional Taxonomy of Cancer Misinformation on Reddit
summary: Cancer-related discussions on social media provide an important space for information exchange and peer support, but also facilitate the spread of misinformation that may influence prevention, screening, and treatment decisions. Existing research on cancer misinformation often relies on narrow definitions, small-scale datasets, or binary labeling frameworks. We introduce a multi-dimensional taxonomy for characterizing cancer misinformation in Reddit discussions of breast, lung, colon, and prostate cancer. The taxonomy captures seven dimensions, including misinformation presence, information type, risk level, stance, and topical focus. Using expert-annotated data, we evaluate multiple large language models (LLMs) for scalable misinformation annotation and analyze cancer misinformation across Reddit communities. Our results show that cancer-related misinformation constitutes approximately 6\% of Reddit cancer discussions, with substantial variation across communities and misinformation topics. Few-shot prompting substantially improves classification performance, particularly for nuanced taxonomy dimensions. We additionally identify recurring misinformation narratives centered on unsupported treatments, distrust of conventional medicine, and misleading claims about diagnosis and screening. Our taxonomy, dataset, and findings provide a foundation for multi-dimensional modeling of online cancer misinformation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个七维分类体系，用于刻画Reddit平台上关于乳腺癌、肺癌、结肠癌和前列腺癌的虚假信息。研究发现约6%的癌症讨论包含虚假信息，且在不同社区和主题间差异显著。通过少样本提示可以显著提升分类性能。
AI.motivation: 现有癌症虚假信息研究多依赖狭窄定义、小规模数据集或二元标注框架，缺乏对虚假信息多维度特征的系统刻画。
AI.method: 提出了一个包含7个维度（虚假信息存在性、信息类型、风险等级、立场、主题焦点等）的分类体系，利用专家标注数据评估多个大语言模型（LLMs）的可扩展标注能力。
AI.result: 癌症虚假信息约占Reddit癌症讨论的6%，不同社区和主题间差异明显。少样本提示显著提升了分类性能，特别是在细粒度分类维度上。
AI.conclusion: 本文的分类体系、数据集和发现为在线癌症虚假信息的多维度建模奠定了基础，识别出无根据疗法、对传统医学的不信任以及关于诊断和筛查的误导性主张等反复出现的虚假信息叙事。

title: Function-Aware Fill-in-the-Middle as Mid-Training for Coding Agent Foundation Models
summary: Coding agents must integrate external tool returns into ongoing reasoning - a capability that standard left-to-right pretraining on code exposes only in its forward direction. We observe that the action-observation-continuation loop of a coding agent is structurally isomorphic to a function call site, where a caller binds arguments, a callee returns a value computed elsewhere, and downstream code consumes that value. This conditioning structure exists at internet scale in ordinary code. We exploit it through function-aware fill-in-the-middle (FIM) mid-training: a self-supervised objective that masks functions selected via program dependency graph analysis and a complexity-inferability double criterion. We mid-train Qwen2.5-Coder-Instruct (7B/14B) and Qwen3-8B on a 2.6B-token decontaminated corpus drawn from 968 GitHub repositories, then apply existing agentic post-training pipelines. Mid-training improves SWE-Bench-Verified by +2.8/+3.0 at 7B/14B and by +3.2 on Qwen3-8B; SWE-Bench-Lite gains are +3.7/+4.0/+5.4 on the same models. The improvement holds across two post-training pipelines (R2E-Gym, SWE-Smith) and on a non-Qwen2.5 base (Qwen3-8B with SWE-Lego). Beyond in-domain gains, mid-training also mitigates the capability erosion that agentic post-training otherwise inflicts on non-agent coding (e.g., LiveCodeBench) and non-coding tool-use benchmarks (tau-bench, BFCL): although the mid-training corpus contains Python code only, the function-call inductive bias survives post-training and yields consistent gains.

AI.tldr: 本文提出函数感知的中间填充（FIM）中训练方法，通过程序依赖图分析和复杂度-可推断性双重标准选择函数进行掩码，在2.6B token语料上中训练Qwen2.5-Coder-Instruct和Qwen3-8B，显著提升SWE-Bench等编码智能体基准性能，并缓解智能体后训练对非编码能力的侵蚀。
AI.motivation: 编码智能体需要将外部工具返回结果整合到持续推理中，但标准从左到右的预训练仅暴露前向能力。作者观察到编码智能体的行动-观察-持续循环与函数调用站点结构同构，希望利用互联网代码中广泛存在的函数调用结构来改进智能体推理能力。
AI.method: 提出函数感知的中间填充（FIM）中训练方法：通过程序依赖图分析识别函数，采用复杂度-可推断性双重标准选择目标函数进行掩码，在2.6B token的968个GitHub仓库去污染语料上中训练Qwen2.5-Coder-Instruct（7B/14B）和Qwen3-8B，随后应用现有智能体后训练流程。
AI.result: 中训练使SWE-Bench-Verified在7B/14B上提升+2.8/+3.0，Qwen3-8B提升+3.2；SWE-Bench-Lite分别提升+3.7/+4.0/+5.4。改进在两个后训练流程（R2E-Gym、SWE-Smith）和Qwen3-8B上均有效。此外还缓解了智能体后训练对LiveCodeBench、tau-bench、BFCL等非编码基准的能力侵蚀。
AI.conclusion: 函数感知的FIM中训练通过利用代码中函数调用结构的归纳偏置，有效提升了编码智能体的工具使用推理能力，且该偏置能在智能体后训练后保持并迁移到非Python基准，验证了其通用性和鲁棒性。

title: Ring-Zero: Scaling Zero RL to a Trillion Parameters for Emergent Reasoning
summary: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards without human-annotated data, often referred to as zero RL, has emerged as a powerful paradigm for eliciting chain-of-thought reasoning. However, due to computational constraints, existing studies are largely restricted to small models, leaving the training dynamics and emergent capabilities at a large scale unexplored. To meaningfully explore this frontier, we aim to elicit high-quality reasoning behaviors from the model. However, we find that naive scaling often suffers from poor readability, token redundancy, and a lack of adaptive reasoning depth. To address these challenges, we present a stable and efficient training pipeline, incorporating algorithmic and system optimizations such as clipped importance sampling, training-inference ratio correction, and mixed-precision control. Our experiments offer three key findings that validate the "bitter lesson" of scaling: (1) scaling to 1T parameters significantly enhances sample efficiency and performance ceilings; (2) the training process progresses sequentially through an initial discovery phase followed by a sharpening phase; and (3) the model spontaneously develops advanced cognitive behaviors, including anthropomorphism, structured formatting, self-verification, parallel reasoning, and context anxiety, rendering hand-crafted heuristics redundant. Evaluated on seven mathematical benchmarks, Ring-2.5-1T-Zero achieves competitive performance. Additionally, to assess CoT quality beyond final-answer correctness, we propose a structured evaluation framework across three dimensions: comprehensibility, reproducibility, and efficiency, where our model demonstrates clear advantages in producing structured and concise reasoning traces. By sharing our observed emergent phenomena, we hope to provide the community with deeper insights into scaling behaviors, particularly at the 1-trillion scale.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种稳定高效的零强化学习训练流水线，在1T参数规模下验证了缩放定律的"苦涩教训"，发现模型能自发涌现拟人化、结构化格式化、自验证、并行推理等高级认知行为，并在七个数学基准上取得竞争性表现。
AI.motivation: 现有零强化学习研究受计算资源限制，主要局限于小模型，大规模下的训练动力学和涌现能力尚未被探索。同时，简单缩放存在可读性差、标记冗余、缺乏自适应推理深度等问题。
AI.method: 提出稳定高效的训练流水线，包含剪裁重要性采样、训练-推理比率校正、混合精度控制等算法和系统优化，在1T参数规模下进行实验。
AI.result: 三个关键发现：(1) 1T参数显著提升样本效率和性能上限；(2) 训练过程按发现阶段→锐化阶段顺序推进；(3) 模型自发涌现拟人化、结构化格式化、自验证、并行推理、上下文焦虑等高级认知行为。在七个数学基准上取得竞争性表现，并提出包含可理解性、可复现性、效率的三维评估框架。
AI.conclusion: 验证了大规模缩放的有效性，观察到模型自发涌现的高级认知行为使手工启发式设计变得多余，为社区提供了1T规模下缩放行为的深入见解。

title: Semantic-Edge Response Decoding of SAM3 for Zero-Shot Crack Segmentation
summary: Crack segmentation is essential for infrastructure inspection and structural health assessment, but existing high-performance methods typically require task-specific pixel-level annotations and training. Text-promptable vision foundation models enable zero-shot deployment, yet their final mask proposals are poorly suited to thin, fragmented, and low-contrast cracks, whose evidence may be suppressed, truncated, or over-expanded during mask generation. We find that language-conditioned semantic responses within the SAM3 decoder preserve more continuous and complete crack evidence than its final masks. Based on this observation, we propose Semantic-Edge Response Decoding (SERD), which interprets internal responses as a dense crack-likelihood field, calibrates them with a lightweight edge prior, and generates crack masks using a unified global threshold, without annotation or fine-tuning. Experiments on six public datasets show that SERD consistently improves over native SAM3 and outperforms the compared zero-shot and open-vocabulary segmentation methods, achieving an average Crack IoU of 61.14\%, 4.63 points higher than SAM3. Further analyses show that most gains arise from directly decoding internal semantic responses, while edge calibration improves structural recovery and false-positive control without increasing end-to-end inference overhead. These results suggest that, for thin and non-compact targets, internal continuous responses can provide a more transferable interface than the final masks of foundation models. Code is available at: https://github.com/xauat-liushipeng/SERD

AI.tldr: 针对现有高精度裂纹分割方法依赖像素级标注、SAM3等视觉基础模型对细长、低对比度裂缝分割效果差的问题，本文提出语义边响应解码（SERD）方法，利用SAM3解码器内部语义响应作为密集裂纹似然场，结合轻量边缘先验和全局阈值生成裂纹掩码，无需标注与微调。在6个数据集上平均Crack IoU达61.14%，比SAM3提升4.63个百分点。
AI.motivation: 现有裂纹分割方法要么需要大量像素级标注进行训练，高精度但泛化性差；要么利用视觉基础模型（如SAM）进行零样本分割，但SAM等模型生成的最终掩码对细长、碎片化、低对比度的裂纹结构不友好，裂纹证据常被抑制、截断或过度膨胀。作者希望在不依赖标注和微调的前提下，提升基础模型对裂纹这类非紧凑目标的分割性能。
AI.method: 提出SERD方法：1) 利用SAM3解码器内部的语言条件语义响应（而非最终掩码），将其解释为密集裂纹似然场；2) 用轻量边缘先验对响应进行校准；3) 采用统一的全局阈值直接生成裂纹掩码，无需标注或微调。
AI.result: 在6个公开数据集上，SERD平均Crack IoU为61.14%，比SAM3高出4.63个百分点，持续优于对比的零样本和开放词汇分割方法。消融实验表明，主要增益来自直接解码内部语义响应，边缘校准进一步改善了结构恢复和假阳性控制，且不增加端到端推理开销。
AI.conclusion: 对于细长、非紧凑的检测目标，基础模型内部的连续响应比最终掩码提供了更具迁移性的接口。SERD为利用基础模型进行结构健康监测中的裂纹分割提供了高效、免标注的实用方案。

title: From Observation to Insight: Mechanistic World Models and the Quest for Autonomous Discovery
summary: Recent advances in foundation models have transformed AI for Science, enabling remarkably accurate predictive performance across domains ranging from protein folding to weather forecasting. Yet prediction alone does not constitute scientific discovery. Scientific understanding depends on uncovering the reusable explanatory mechanisms that generate observations, whereas contemporary machine learning remains fundamentally organised around predictive mappings rather than explanatory structure. In this paper, we argue that scientific discovery is fundamentally a problem of knowledge organisation. To this end, we introduce Mechanistic World Models, a new design paradigm that places reusable mechanisms at the centre of representation, computation and learning. Drawing on insights from the philosophy of science, we derive the computational capabilities required for discovery, identify the design principles and inductive pressures that encourage explanatory knowledge to emerge, and formalise the anatomy of a mechanism-centric world model. Finally, we show how diverse research directions including mechanistic interpretability, causal representation learning, equation discovery and modular architectures capture complementary ingredients of this paradigm while lacking a unified framework. We propose Mechanistic World Models as a conceptual foundation and computational blueprint for moving AI beyond predictive forecasting towards autonomous scientific discovery.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"机械论世界模型"这一新范式，主张科学发现本质是知识组织问题，应将可复用的解释性机制而非预测映射置于AI学习的核心，从而实现从预测到自主科学发现的跨越。
AI.motivation: 现有AI虽在预测任务上表现优异，但预测不等于科学发现；科学理解依赖于揭示产生观测结果的可复用解释机制，而当前机器学习仍以预测映射而非解释性结构为核心组织方式。
AI.method: 从科学哲学中汲取洞见，推导科学发现所需的计算能力，设计促进解释性知识涌现的归纳压力，并形式化机制中心世界模型的架构；整合机械论可解释性、因果表征学习、方程发现和模块化架构等研究方向。
AI.result: 提出了"机械论世界模型"作为计算蓝图，识别了多种现有研究方向虽包含该范式的互补要素但缺乏统一框架的现状。
AI.conclusion: 机械论世界模型可作为推动AI从预测性预测走向自主科学发现的概念基础和计算蓝图。

title: WikiSTAR: A System for Shedding Light on the Hidden History of Scientific Wikipedia Articles
summary: Wikipedia plays a key role in shaping public understanding of science, and its openly accessible revision history is a unique record of how scientific knowledge evolves over time. Yet scientifically meaningful revisions are obscured by the sheer volume of routine edits, leaving each article's scientific history hidden. We present WikiSTAR (Scientific Tracking of Article Revisions), an interactive system for exploring scientifically meaningful changes across an article's revision history. Using an LLM classifier with an expert-designed multi-label taxonomy, WikiSTAR first tags edit types such as the addition of technical terms, new research findings, and changes in scientific narrative. Then, through interactive views, an article's full revision history can be traced at any granularity - from aggregate trends that reveal when and in which sections scientific content was added or refined, down to individual edits - showing how scientific knowledge develops at a scale previously impossible. In a user study, experts from three domains found that WikiSTAR surfaced new patterns and research questions and enabled previously impractical analyses. We release our system, code and a human-annotated benchmark.

AI.tldr: WikiSTAR是一个交互式系统，利用LLM分类器和专家设计的多标签分类法，从维基百科海量修订历史中识别并可视化科学上有意义的变更，帮助用户追踪科学知识的演化过程。
AI.motivation: 维基百科在塑造公众对科学的理解中至关重要，但其修订历史中真正有科学意义的变更被大量常规编辑所掩盖，导致每篇文章的科学演化历史难以被挖掘和理解。
AI.method: 开发了WikiSTAR系统，包含两个核心组件：(1) 基于LLM的分类器，使用专家设计的多标签分类法标记编辑类型（如添加技术术语、新研究发现、科学叙事变化等）；(2) 交互式可视化界面，支持从聚合趋势到单个编辑的多粒度探索。
AI.result: 三个领域的专家用户研究发现，WikiSTAR能够揭示新的模式和研究问题，实现了以往难以进行的分析。系统、代码和人工标注基准已公开发布。
AI.conclusion: WikiSTAR通过智能分类和交互式可视化，成功将维基百科的修订历史转化为可探索的科学知识演化记录，为研究科学知识传播与演变提供了规模化分析工具。

title: Language Identification with Succinct Machine-Independent Traces
summary: Motivated by the power of large language models, there has been renewed interest in the Gold-Angluin model of language identification in the limit, with an eye toward variants of the model that might overcome the negative results for its original formulation. Recent papers on this question have proposed looking at computational traces and annotations of training strings as a source of additional power for a learner, reflecting empirical regularities such as the way that commented source code is easier to learn from than arbitrary source code, and text annotated with algorithmically generated chain-of-thought tokens can be easier to learn from than the raw text itself. This recent work has shown positive results for language identification in the presence of such computational traces, but the traces in these positive results come from explicit automata-theoretic machine models that generate the language, where the underlying vocabulary of tokens for the traces is very large. In this paper, we address two fundamental issues left open by this line of work: can we achieve positive results with traces that use only a small alphabet, and can we define traces directly from the language itself, without requiring an underlying machine model that generates it? We establish positive results for both of these questions: for an arbitrary collection of languages, we show how to define computational traces that enable identification in the limit, using an alphabet of tokens that is linear in the size of the alphabet that the languages are defined over, and independent of any other properties of the languages.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了在Gold-Angluin语言识别模型中，通过使用小字母表的计算轨迹来实现极限识别，并且这些轨迹可以直接从语言本身定义，无需依赖底层的机器模型。
AI.motivation: 受大语言模型能力的启发，研究者重新关注Gold-Angluin语言极限识别模型，希望找到克服原模型负面结果的方法。先前工作表明计算轨迹和注释能增强学习能力，但存在两个未解决问题：轨迹使用超大词汇表，且依赖生成语言的自动机模型。
AI.method: 作者针对任意语言集合，设计了一种计算轨迹的定义方式，使得轨迹使用的字母表大小与语言定义所用字母表大小呈线性关系，且不依赖于语言的任何其他属性，直接从语言本身定义轨迹。
AI.result: 成功建立了两个正面结果：1）可以使用小字母表（线性于原语言字母表大小）的计算轨迹实现极限识别；2）轨迹可以直接从语言本身定义，无需依赖生成语言的底层机器模型。
AI.conclusion: 本文解决了现有工作中两个关键开放问题，证明了即使使用小字母表的计算轨迹，且轨迹直接从语言定义，也能实现语言极限识别，为语言学习的理论基础提供了重要进展。

title: MobileSAM2: Lightweight Segment Anything for Spatial Intelligence
summary: The recent large video foundation model, SAM2, enables segment anything in both images and videos, serving as a powerful base model for various applications. However, many of such use cases require to operate on resource-constrained devices like mobile phones and laptops. In this work, we aim to make SAM2 more mobile-friendly by distilling the heavyweight SAM2 into a lightweight model, facilitating segment anything in both images and videos on mobile devices. To this end, we propose Hypergraphical Knowledge Distill (HyperKD), which introduces the idea of hypergraph into knowledge distillation, aiming to effectively model and transfer SAM2's generalizable and comprehensive knowledge. HyperKD consists of Temporal HyperKD and Granularity HyperKD that construct hypergraphs to explicitly model and extract the generalizable temporal knowledge and the comprehensive multi-granularity knowledge from SAM2 respectively, which are then distilled into the lightweight student model by aligning it with the constructed hypergraphs. Besides, we present MobileSAM2, a new family of lightweight SAM2 that balances efficiency and effectiveness via searching the best model architectures with HyperKD during model size reduction. Extensive experiments validate MobileSAM2 across multiple benchmarks and show promising generalization performance on embodied AI tasks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出HyperKD知识蒸馏方法，将重型SAM2模型压缩为轻量级MobileSAM2，使其能在手机等资源受限设备上实现图像和视频的分割一切。
AI.motivation: SAM2作为强大的视频基础模型，在许多应用中需要在手机、笔记本等资源受限设备上运行，但其模型过于沉重，无法直接部署到移动端。
AI.method: 提出Hypergraphical Knowledge Distill (HyperKD)，包含Temporal HyperKD和Granularity HyperKD两个部分，分别通过构建超图来建模和提取SAM2中的通用时序知识和多粒度知识，并将这些知识蒸馏到轻量级学生模型中；同时搜索最佳模型架构得到MobileSAM2系列模型。
AI.result: 在多个基准上经过广泛实验验证，MobileSAM2在保持效率的同时展现了良好的分割性能，并在具身AI任务上表现出优异的泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: HyperKD能有效将SAM2的通用知识蒸馏到轻量级模型，MobileSAM2实现了在移动设备上高效进行图像和视频分割的目标。

title: The Model Knows Your Project, Not You: Measuring Recognition in LLMs with NameRank
summary: What a frontier model recalls about a person or tool from its own weights -- before any retrieval step -- often shapes the first description a human sees, making that parametric corpus presence a measurement problem. Citations explain about a third of whether a model recognizes a researcher; we target the residual and build NameRank, a [0,1] recognition score: each of 4,685 entities in 54 cohorts is probed with one open-ended question across 36 models, and an independent judge returns a binary verdict against a curated gold -- did the model state a specific, non-guessable fact about this exact entity? -- so hallucination, context echo, and guesses earn nothing. Synthetic-null entities hold the floor near zero, and verdicts track the entity, not the model. One thesis organizes the findings: recognition is paid to named, indexable artifacts, not to credentials or titles. Every Olympic-style credential sits below a working-researcher baseline, because no named artifact ships with the medal, yet the ranking inverts at the marquee tier, where Nobel, Turing, and Fields laureates saturate the panel. For independent creators the tool out-ranks its maker, and the credential that does propagate is a named method or awarded paper. Being one of many named contributors to a celebrated artifact, by contrast, earns almost nothing -- the authors listed on a flagship model report or system card sit near the recognition floor -- because recognition attaches to the artifact's own distinctive name, not to the roster behind it. No bibliometric predicts recognition well; top-density institutions out-recognize peers at matched citations; and on 258 news events recognition loads on peak salience, not persistence. A self-report probe shows introspection reads a corpus prior, not its own knowledge.

AI.tldr: 本文提出NameRank，一个[0,1]的识别分数，测量36个前沿模型对4,685个实体（54个队列）的参数量级知识。发现模型识别的是有名称的可索引工件，而非凭证书或头衔；工具排名高于其创造者；命名方法和获奖论文是唯一能传播的凭据；巅峰声望事件比持续性更能驱动识别。
AI.motivation: 前沿模型在检索前从其权重中回忆的关于人或工具的内容，往往决定了人类看到的第一描述，因此参数化语料库的存在性成为一个测量问题。引文只能解释约三分之一的模型识别研究者的原因，作者希望针对剩余部分进行测量。
AI.method: 构建NameRank评分：对54个队列中的4,685个实体，跨36个模型用开放式问题探测，独立评判者依据预定义黄金标准返回二元判决——模型是否陈述了关于该实体的具体、不可猜测的事实。使用合成空实体作为基线，并对比模型自我报告与语料库先验。
AI.result: 模型识别关注有名称的可索引工件，而非凭证书或头衔；奥林匹克级凭据低于工作研究者基线，但诺贝尔/图灵/菲尔兹奖得主饱和面板；工具排名高于创造者；作为著名工件的多名贡献者之一的作者接近识别地板；顶级密度机构识别高于同等引用水平匹配的同行；新闻事件中识别加载于峰值声望而非持续性。
AI.conclusion: 模型识别附着于工件自身独特名称，而非其背后的名单；自我报告探测显示模型内省的是语料库先验而非自身知识。

title: What Does a Temporal Benchmark Score Measure? Decomposing Channel Use in Video VLM Evaluation
summary: A score on a temporal video question answering benchmark is meant to measure that a model has temporal understanding, but it conflates two questions. 1. The task question: is the question even temporal, does it need several frames and their order? and 2. The channel question, when it does, does the model recover the order from the pixels, or read it off the positional encoding (RoPE)? Most of a temporal score answers neither, a single frame and answer priors often carry it. The field's validity checks, frame-shuffle sensitivity and the accuracy gained from the full video, speak only to the task question. We contribute a label-free screen for the channel question, the reversal-drop: the accuracy lost when the visual sequence is reversed while RoPE remains forward. It can be applied to compatible temporal benchmarks without new annotations. Paired reverse labels, or tasks whose labels transform deterministically under reversal, distinguish models that follow reversed content from those merely disrupted by the conflict. Molmo2 answers the forward event reading order off positions, while Qwen3-VL answers the reversed event it actually sees, reading visual order (comparatively). We call them position-dominant and visual-sequence-dominant. The split holds across two benchmarks and several temporal tasks at two scales, and activation patching shows it is a real internal property, not an artifact of the conflict. The distinction matters, the two channels fail on opposite inputs so two models with similar score are not interchangable, i.e. an aggregate score does not reflect potential failure modes.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种无需标注的“反转丢弃”方法，用于区分视频问答模型中依赖位置编码（RoPE）还是依赖视觉内容理解时序。发现不同模型存在“位置主导”和“视觉序列主导”两种类型，且聚合分数无法反映模型的真实失效模式。
AI.motivation: 现有时间视频问答基准的分数混淆了两个问题：任务问题（问题是否需要时序理解）和通道问题（模型是从像素中恢复顺序还是从位置编码中读取）。大部分分数无法区分这两者，导致评估失效。
AI.method: 提出“反转丢弃”（reversal-drop）方法：将视觉序列反转但保持RoPE正向，通过准确率下降程度来检测模型是否真正依赖视觉内容理解时序。可应用于兼容的时序基准，无需新标注。
AI.result: Molmo2属于“位置主导”型（从位置编码读取顺序），Qwen3-VL属于“视觉序列主导”型（真正阅读反转后的视觉内容）。这一区分在两个基准和多个时序任务上成立，且激活修补实验证明这是模型内部真实属性。
AI.conclusion: 两种通道在不同输入上会失败，因此分数相似的模型不可互换，聚合分数无法反映潜在的失效模式。区分模型依赖何种通道对模型评估和部署至关重要。

title: KnowAct-GUIClaw: Know Deeply, Act Perfectly, Personal GUI Assistant with Self-Evolving Memory and Skill
summary: OpenClaw has emerged as a leading agent framework for complex task automation, yet it faces insufficient cross-platform GUI interaction support and a well-built self-evolution mechanism. These flaws limit its adaptation to diverse device ecosystems and prevent performance improvements through continuous learning from execution experience. To resolve these issues, we propose the Know Deeply, Act Perfectly paradigm for personal assistants, which holds that accumulated user interaction and task-running experience directly improve execution accuracy and efficiency, unifying cognitive comprehension and operational execution. Based on this paradigm, we introduce KnowAct-GUIClaw, a novel Know-Route-Act-Reflect framework designed to address OpenClaw's GUI manipulation deficits and break through its cross-platform and recursive self-improvement constraints. First, the host agent leverages accumulated interaction experience and task-relevant knowledge for long-horizon task decomposition and allocation (Know). Second, a pluggable GUI subagent with an experience-attributable memory system (Know) and self-evolving skill library (Act), enabling seamless cross-platform migration and fast-path integration. Especially, this framework continuously stores user profiles and feedback to improve the accuracy of task decomposition and tool calls. Extensive experiments across Android, iOS, HarmonyOS and Windows show that KnowAct-GUIClaw achieves superior efficiency, accuracy and cross-platform adaptability. Especially, the GUIClaw with open-source Kimi-2.6 models achieves the best performance (64.1%) on the long-horizon MobileWorld benchmark, beating all agentical frameworks and closed-source agentical models, e.g., Seed-2.0-Pro and GPT-5.5. Additionally, the knowledgeable memory and execution skills supported by our framework are transferable across diverse base models, improving by 8.5% with Kimi-2.6.

AI.tldr: 提出KnowAct-GUIClaw框架，通过知识驱动和经验积累解决OpenClaw在跨平台GUI交互和自我进化方面的不足，在多个操作系统上实现高效准确的跨平台任务自动化。
AI.motivation: OpenClaw虽为领先的智能体框架，但缺乏跨平台GUI交互支持和自我进化机制，限制了其在多样设备生态的适应性和持续学习能力。
AI.method: 基于"深度认知、完美行动"范式，提出Know-Route-Act-Reflect框架：主机智能体利用经验进行长时任务分解与分配（Know）；可插拔GUI子智能体配备经验归因记忆系统（Know）和自进化技能库（Act），实现跨平台迁移和快速路径集成。
AI.result: 在Android、iOS、HarmonyOS和Windows上取得优越性能；基于Kimi-2.6的GUIClaw在MobileWorld基准上达64.1%，超越所有闭源模型（如Seed-2.0-Pro、GPT-5.5）；知识记忆和执行技能可跨模型迁移，提升8.5%。
AI.conclusion: KnowAct-GUIClaw有效解决了OpenClaw的两大缺陷，验证了知识积累和经验反馈对提升任务执行精度和跨平台适应性的关键作用。

title: DM-KG: A Novel Method for Boosting Spatial Cognition of Vision-Language Models in Street View Imagery
summary: As vision-language models (VLMs) are increasingly deployed in geospatial question answering and visual scene understanding, improving their spatial cognition capability on street view imagery for complex logical reasoning has emerged as a key research priority. However, existing VLMs frequently suffer from "spatial semantic hallucinations" when perceiving object locations, distances, and directions in real-world street view scenes. Furthermore, such errors are often recalcitrant to tracing and calibration, posing a critical bottleneck for their practical deployment in geospatial tasks. To address this pressing challenge, this study proposes DM-KG (Direction-Metric Knowledge Graph), a structurally grounded spatial representation framework for street view imagery. By explicitly extracting directional and metric relationships between entities from a single 2D image, this framework enhances the spatial reasoning accuracy of VLMs through a structured knowledge graph. Specifically, we integrate panoptic segmentation with metric depth estimation to robustly compute entity-level 3D spatial coordinates. Subsequently, we encode the clock azimuths and Euclidean distances of entity pairs into a JSON-formatted knowledge graph, which is injected into the VLM as an explicit geometric prior to guide spatial reasoning. Experimental results on public spatial question-answering (QA) benchmarks demonstrate that DM-KG reduces the mean absolute error (MAE) in distance estimation by 31.1% and the mean angular error in direction judgment by 65.8%, while simultaneously maintaining a high QA success rate. By establishing a complete, augmented reasoning pipeline, this research significantly improves the spatial cognitive capabilities of VLMs in street view scenarios, thereby providing a flexible, generalized, and interpretable framework for geographic visual question answering (GeoVQA) in open environments.

AI.tldr: 本文提出DM-KG框架，通过构建方向-度量知识图谱来增强视觉语言模型在街景图像中的空间推理能力，在距离估计和方向判断误差上分别降低31.1%和65.8%。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉语言模型在街景图像的空间感知中常出现"空间语义幻觉"，难以准确定位物体位置、距离和方向，且这类错误难以追溯和校正，制约了其在地理空间任务中的实际部署。
AI.method: 集成全景分割与度量深度估计，计算实体级3D空间坐标；将实体对的时钟方位角和欧氏距离编码为JSON格式知识图谱；将图谱作为显式几何先验注入VLM，引导空间推理。
AI.result: 在公开空间问答基准上，距离估计平均绝对误差降低31.1%，方向判断平均角度误差降低65.8%，同时保持高问答成功率。
AI.conclusion: DM-KG为街景场景下的地理视觉问答提供了一种灵活、通用且可解释的结构化空间表示框架，显著提升了VLM的空间认知能力。

title: Vertical Standardisation for High-Risk AI Systems under the EU AI Act: A Domain-Specific Framework for Algorithmic Hiring
summary: According to the recent European legislation, high-risk AI systems will have to adapt in order to comply with requirements related to specific areas, like risk management, data quality and governance, logging and traceability, technical documentation, transparency, human oversight, and accuracy, as outlined in the European Artificial Intelligence (AI) Act. As the standardisation process for AI is expected to remain iterative and, so far, there are no European standards on AI fully covering the challenges of algorithmic hiring, we propose specific standardisation-oriented recommendations related to the relevant AI areas specified by the European Commission. For each of these areas, we set the context by describing the requirements that AI systems in high-risk domains, and especially in recruitment, should fulfil, as well as the activities that should be carried out to ensure their appropriate use and desired performance, in line with the requirements deriving from the AI Act. Unlike existing horizontal approaches to AI governance and standardisation, this paper contributes a vertical, domain-specific framework for algorithmic hiring, and especially ranking-based recruitment systems, by mapping the requirements of the AI Act to concrete standardisation recommendations, focusing on lifecycle discrimination risks, fairness-aware data governance, explainability, human oversight, and post-deployment monitoring in recruitment systems. Even though our recommendations were informed by the outcomes of the European project FINDHR, they are not tied to the project's technical artefacts and could be implemented using alternative methods, tools, or governance mechanisms.

AI.tldr: 本文针对欧盟《人工智能法案》对高风险AI系统的要求，为算法招聘系统（特别是基于排名的招聘系统）提出了具体的标准化建议，涵盖风险管理、数据治理、可解释性、人工监督和部署后监控等领域。
AI.motivation: 欧盟《人工智能法案》要求高风险AI系统在风险管理、数据质量、日志记录、透明度、人工监督等方面合规，但目前缺乏针对算法招聘的欧洲标准，因此需要提出领域特定的标准化建议。
AI.method: 采用垂直、领域特定的框架方法，将AI法案的要求映射到算法招聘系统的具体标准化建议中，重点关注生命周期中的歧视风险、公平感知数据治理、可解释性、人工监督和部署后监控。
AI.result: 提出了一套针对算法招聘系统的标准化建议，该方法不依赖于特定技术工件，可替代方法、工具或治理机制实施。
AI.conclusion: 本文提供了与现有横向AI治理方法不同的垂直领域框架，为高风险招聘AI系统合规提供了具体指导。

title: Agentic Service-Oriented Computing: A Manifesto for the Next Frontier of Service-Oriented Computing
comment: Accepted at the 2026 IEEE International Conference on Web Services (ICWS); Corresponding author: Prof. Amin Beheshti; DOI 10.1109/ICWS72778.2026.00163
summary: The rapid emergence of LLM-powered autonomous and semi-autonomous agents is reshaping software systems from static, request-response components into goal-directed, adaptive, and tool-using computational actors. As these agents move from isolated cognitive prototypes into complex distributed workflows, they confront challenges that the Service-Oriented Computing community has studied for more than two decades: composition, interoperability, quality of service, lifecycle management, governance, security, and trust. Yet much of today's agentic AI ecosystem is developing these foundations ad hoc, without the engineering rigour required for dependable enterprise and societal deployment. This paper introduces Agentic Service-Oriented Computing (ASOC) as a new research and practice area concerned with engineering agents as services, orchestrating services through autonomous and semi-autonomous agents, and governing ecosystems of agents and services under constraints of trust, cybersecurity, compliance, performance, and accountability. We articulate six foundational principles of ASOC (harness-ability, composability, lifecycle engineering, trustworthiness by design, goal-driven orchestration, and observability/accountability) and organise a five-dimensional research agenda spanning: (i) agentic services foundations and lifecycle engineering; (ii) composition, orchestration, and interoperability; (iii) governance, observability, and accountability; (iv) security, trust, and risk management; and (v) evaluation, certification, and Agentic QoS. We argue that the Services Computing community is especially well positioned to provide the conceptual and engineering spine for this emerging field, transforming agentic AI from fragmented demonstrations into dependable, service-based systems worthy of human and organisational trust.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Agentic Service-Oriented Computing (ASOC)作为新的研究和实践领域，将服务计算的原则与方法应用于LLM驱动的自主/半自主智能体系统，解决其工程化、可组合性、治理、安全与信任等核心挑战，并提出六项基础原则和五维研究议程。
AI.motivation: 当前LLM驱动的智能体系统从静态原型转向复杂分布式工作流，面临服务计算领域已研究二十多年的挑战（如组合、互操作、QoS、治理、安全与信任），但业界缺乏工程化严谨性，为此需要将服务计算的成熟工程原则引入智能体AI领域。
AI.method: 提出Agentic Service-Oriented Computing (ASOC)概念框架，定义六项基础原则（可驾驭性、可组合性、生命周期工程、可信设计、目标驱动编排、可观测性与问责性），并组织五维研究议程（智能体服务基础与生命周期工程、组合编排与互操作、治理可观测性与问责性、安全信任与风险管理、评估认证与智能体QoS）。
AI.result: 建立了ASOC作为连接服务计算与智能体AI的桥梁框架，明确了服务计算社区在该新兴领域中的核心工程支撑角色，为将智能体AI从碎片化演示转变为可信赖的、基于服务的系统提供了系统化蓝图。
AI.conclusion: 服务计算社区具备为智能体AI提供概念与工程脊柱的独特优势，ASOC框架有望将智能体AI从零散原型转化为值得人类和组织信赖的、基于服务的可靠系统。

title: Segregate, Refine, Integrate: Decomposing Multimodal Fusion for Sentiment Analysis
summary: Multimodal fusion must simultaneously refine modality-specific signals and model cross-modal interactions; two competing objectives typically entangled within the same operation. We propose \textbf{SeRIn} (\textbf{Se}gregate, \textbf{R}efine, \textbf{In}tegrate), a multimodal LM fusion scheme that enforces this separation as an architectural prior. Modality-specific representations evolve along isolated pathways, each refined against its respective encoder context, while a dedicated cross-modal pathway accumulates their joint evolution without contaminating unimodal streams. Full cross-modal interaction is deferred to a final prediction step - ablations confirm that structured interactions, not added capacity, drive the gains; gate analysis under visual corruption reveals emergent modality reweighting without explicit supervision. SeRIn achieves state-of-the-art results on CH-SIMS and CMU-MOSEI, improving all metrics on both benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 提出SeRIn多模态融合方案，通过分离模态特定信号与跨模态交互（先隔离精炼各模态，再统一集成），在CH-SIMS和CMU-MOSEI上达到SOTA。
AI.motivation: 多模态融合需要同时精炼模态特定信号和建模跨模态交互，但两者通常纠缠在同一操作中，SeRIn旨在通过架构先验强制分离这两个目标。
AI.method: SeRIn方案包含三个步骤：Segregate（隔离各模态表示沿独立路径演化）、Refine（各自针对编码器上下文精炼）、Integrate（专用跨模态路径累积联合演化，最终预测阶段才进行完整跨模态交互）。
AI.result: 在CH-SIMS和CMU-MOSEI基准上所有指标均达到SOTA；消融实验证实结构化交互而非增加容量驱动性能提升；门控分析显示在视觉损坏下涌现出无需显式监督的模态重新加权能力。
AI.conclusion: 明确分离模态精炼与跨模态融合作为架构先验是有效的，为多模态LM融合提供了更清晰的设计范式。

title: From Critic to Confidence: PPO for Language-Based Quantitative Prediction with Confidence Estimation
summary: LLMs can perform language-based quantitative prediction from unstructured inputs, but remain susceptible to hallucinations and overconfident errors, making it critical to know not only what a model predicts, but when its predictions can be trusted. We introduce CARE-PPO, a reinforcement learning framework that establishes a connection between loss prediction for uncertainty estimation and actor-critic PPO fine-tuning, enabling joint learning of accurate numerical estimates and reliable confidence signals in language-based quantitative prediction. CARE-PPO uses a Confidence-Aligned Reward for Estimation, defined as a function of prediction error, to provide dense error-aware feedback to the actor while inducing the critic to learn a value function aligned with prediction quality. During inference, we repurpose the critic as a confidence estimator. Across two real-world tasks in healthcare and finance and two Qwen-3 model scales (4B and 8B), CARE-PPO achieves strong quantitative prediction performance, while producing significantly better-aligned confidence estimates through the critic than logit-based and verbalized baselines. These gains persist under realistic out-of-distribution settings across domains, spanning linguistic and domain shifts. Finally, CARE-PPO reduces task-specific overfitting on general instruction-following prompts, consistent with the broader generalization advantages of RL fine-tuning over supervised approaches.

AI.tldr: 提出CARE-PPO框架，通过强化学习将损失预测与PPO微调相结合，在语言定量预测任务中同时学习准确数值估计和可靠置信度信号，在医疗和金融领域取得优于基线方法的效果。
AI.motivation: LLM在语言定量预测中易产生幻觉和过度自信错误，现有方法缺乏可靠的置信度评估机制，需要一种既能准确预测又能可靠衡量预测可信度的方法。
AI.method: 提出CARE-PPO框架，核心是用置信度对齐奖励函数（基于预测误差）为actor提供密集错误反馈，同时引导critic学习与预测质量对齐的价值函数；推理时将critic重用作置信度估计器。
AI.result: 在医疗和金融两个任务、Qwen-3（4B/8B）上取得强定量预测性能；critic产生的置信度估计显著优于基于logit和口头化的基线方法；在分布外场景下保持优势；减少任务特定过拟合。
AI.conclusion: CARE-PPO有效建立了损失预测与策略优化之间的联系，实现预测与置信度联合学习，且RL微调相比监督方法有更好的泛化优势。
